showPointTooltip(e,t){t&&(e.tooltip.refresh(t),e.xAxis[0].removePlotLine("lastPointLine"),e.xAxis[0].addPlotLine({id:"lastPointLine",value:t.x,color:"#d3d3d3",width:1,dashStyle:"Dot",zIndex:5}))}function hideTooltipAndLine(e){e.tooltip.hide(),e.xAxis[0].removePlotLine("lastPointLine")}function updateTooltipState(e,t,o){if(document.getElementById(t).checked){let t;"kospi"===o&&kospiCurrentPoint?t=kospiCurrentPoint:"kosdaq"===o&&kosdaqCurrentPoint?t=kosdaqCurrentPoint:(t=getLastValidPoint(e.series[0]),"kospi"===o?kospiCurrentPoint=t:"kosdaq"===o&&(kosdaqCurrentPoint=t)),showPointTooltip(e,t)}else hideTooltipAndLine(e)}function setupTooltipPersistence(e,t,o){const r=document.getElementById(t);function i(t){if(!r.checked)return;const i=e.pointer.normalize(t),n=e.series[0].searchPoint(i,!0);n&&("kospi"===o?kospiCurrentPoint=n:"kosdaq"===o&&(kosdaqCurrentPoint=n),drawGuidelineWithDot(e,n,!0),e.tooltip.refresh(n),e.xAxis[0].removePlotLine("lastPointLine"),e.xAxis[0].addPlotLine({id:"lastPointLine",value:n.x,color:"#d3d3d3",width:1,dashStyle:"ShortDot",zIndex:5}))}e.container.addEventListener("mousemove",i),e.container.addEventListener("touchmove",i),e.container.addEventListener("mouseleave",(()=>{if(r.checked){const t=e,i=o;setTimeout((()=>{if(r.checked){const o="kospi"===i?kospiCurrentPoint:kosdaqCurrentPoint;o&&(drawGuidelineWithDot(e,o,!1),showPointTooltip(t,o))}}),10)}})),e.container.addEventListener("touchend",(()=>{if(r.checked){const t=e,i=o;setTimeout((()=>{if(r.checked){const o="kospi"===i?kospiCurrentPoint:kosdaqCurrentPoint;o&&(drawGuidelineWithDot(e,o,!1),showPointTooltip(t,o))}}),10)}})),r.addEventListener("change",(()=>{updateTooltipState(e,t,o)}))}function forceToggleCheckbox(e){const t=document.getElementById(e);t&&t.checked&&(t.checked=!1,setTimeout((()=>{t.checked=!0,t.dispatchEvent(new Event("change"))}),5))}function setupCrossChartTooltipFix(e,t,o){const r=document.getElementById(t);o.forEach((e=>{e.container.addEventListener("mouseenter",(()=>{r.checked&&forceToggleCheckbox(t)})),e.container.addEventListener("touchstart",(()=>{r.checked&&forceToggleCheckbox(t)}))}))}function showExtremes(e,t){const o=e.plotLeft,r=e.plotTop;e.renderer.box.querySelectorAll("[data-extreme]").forEach((e=>e.remove())),["min","max"].forEach((i=>{const n=t[i];if(!n)return;n.update({marker:{enabled:!0,radius:6,fillColor:"#9292922e"}},!1);const a=o+n.plotX,s=r+n.plotY,d=Highcharts.dateFormat("%y-%m-%d",n.x),l=i.toUpperCase()+": "+n.y,c="max"===i?-10:6,h="max"===i?4:20;e.renderer.text(d,a+10,s+c).css({fontSize:"0.6rem",fill:"#999",letterSpacing:"-0.3px"}).attr({zIndex:6,"data-extreme":i}).add();const p="max"===i?"#bd5f5fff":"#41679aff";e.renderer.text(l,a+10,s+h).css({fontSize:"0.6rem",fontWeight:"bold",fill:p,letterSpacing:"-0.3px"}).attr({zIndex:6,"data-extreme":i}).add()})),e.redraw()}function clearExtremes(e){e.renderer.box.querySelectorAll("[data-extreme]").forEach((e=>e.remove())),e.series[0].points.forEach((e=>{e.update({marker:{enabled:!1}},!1)})),e.redraw()}function updateExtremes(e,t,o){if(e.renderer.box.querySelectorAll("[data-extreme]").forEach((e=>e.remove())),e.series[0].points.forEach((e=>{e.update({marker:{enabled:!1}},!1)})),t.checked){const t=e.xAxis[0],o=e.series[0].points.filter((e=>e.x>=t.min&&e.x<=t.max&&"null"!==e.formatPrefix));if(o.length){const t=o.slice().sort(((e,t)=>e.y-t.y));showExtremes(e,{min:t[0],max:t[t.length-1]})}e.redraw()}else e.redraw();const r=document.getElementById(o+"TooltipToggle");if(r&&r.checked){const t="kospi"===o?kospiCurrentPoint:kosdaqCurrentPoint;t&&showPointTooltip(e,t)}else hideTooltipAndLine(e)}function setupExtremesToggle(e,t,o){const r=document.getElementById(t);e.xAxis[0].update({events:{afterSetExtremes:function(){updateExtremes(e,r,o)}}},!1),r.addEventListener("change",(function(){updateExtremes(e,r,o)})),window.addEventListener("resize",(function(){r.checked&&forceToggleCheckbox(t)})),updateExtremes(e,r,o)}function setupScrollFadeHandlers(e){const t=e.container.parentNode;t.classList.add("chart-scroll-faded"),t.addEventListener("touchstart",(function(){t.classList.remove("chart-scroll-faded"),t.classList.add("chart-scroll-active")})),t.addEventListener("touchend",(function(){setTimeout((()=>{t.classList.remove("chart-scroll-active"),t.classList.add("chart-scroll-faded")}),1e3)}))}setupExtremesToggle(kospiChart,"kospiExtremesToggle","kospi"),setupExtremesToggle(kosdaqChart,"kosdaqExtremesToggle","kosdaq"),updateTooltipState(kospiChart,"kospiTooltipToggle","kospi"),updateTooltipState(kosdaqChart,"kosdaqTooltipToggle","kosdaq"),setupTooltipPersistence(kospiChart,"kospiTooltipToggle","kospi"),setupTooltipPersistence(kosdaqChart,"kosdaqTooltipToggle","kosdaq"),setupCrossChartTooltipFix(kospiChart,"kospiTooltipToggle",[kosdaqChart]),setupCrossChartTooltipFix(kosdaqChart,"kosdaqTooltipToggle",[kospiChart]),setupScrollFadeHandlers(kospiChart),setupScrollFadeHandlers(kosdaqChart),initializeLastPoints();const syncGroups=[["kospiTooltipToggle","kosdaqTooltipToggle"],["kospiExtremesToggle","kosdaqExtremesToggle"]];function drawGuidelineWithDot(e,t,o=!1){const r=e.plotLeft,i=e.plotTop;e.xAxis[0].removePlotLine("lastPointLine"),e.xAxis[0].addPlotLine({id:"lastPointLine",value:t.x,color:"#d3d3d3",width:1,dashStyle:"ShortDot",zIndex:5}),e.renderer.box.querySelectorAll("[data-hover-dot]").forEach((e=>e.remove()));const n=r+t.plotX,a=i+t.plotY,s=o?9:7,d=o?.4:.3;e.renderer.circle(n,a,s).attr({fill:`rgba(173, 216, 230, ${d})`,stroke:"none","data-hover-dot":!0,zIndex:9}).add(),e.renderer.circle(n,a,4).attr({fill:"rgba(135, 193, 230, 0.7)",stroke:"rgba(173, 216, 230, 0.5)","stroke-width":1,"data-hover-dot":!0,zIndex:10}).add()}function initializeLastPoints(){const e=kospiChart.series[0].points,t=kosdaqChart.series[0].points,o=e=>{for(let t=e.length-1;t>=0;t--)if("null"!==e[t].formatPrefix)return e[t];return null};kospiCurrentPoint=o(e),kosdaqCurrentPoint=o(t)}syncGroups.forEach((([e,t])=>{const o=document.getElementById(e),r=document.getElementById(t);o.addEventListener("change",(()=>{r.checked!==o.checked&&r.click()})),r.addEventListener("change",(()=>{o.checked!==r.checked&&o.click()}))}));</script>
